title: Open DesignFlow
text: You land on your project's Overview: how delivery is going right now.

title: Find your project
text: Use the sidebar to switch projects. Each project has an Overview and a Board.

title: Pick a period
text: Choose This week, This month or This year. Every number on the page updates.

title: Read the flow
text: Scroll down for changes made mid-sprint, estimate vs actual, and delay warning signs.

title: Open the Board
text: Every story by stage: To do, In progress, Done. An amber badge means delayed.

title: Filter the Board
text: Show the Current sprint, only Delayed items, or the Backlog. Or search by name.

title: Open a story
text: Click a card: who has it, when it started, the description, Figma link and files.

title: Tag your comments
text: Comments come from Azure DevOps. Start one with #blocked, #unblocked, #reopen or #done so it counts.

title: Check the metrics
text: How long it took and why it is flagged. Use "Not really late" if the delay was planned.

title: Explain delays
text: See what changed while working, and use "Add reason" to record why it was late.
